name: sp-site-design-harness
description: Research → Design → Prep for Handoff pipeline for WordPress block-theme site design — takes raw brand material to homepage options, then designs the chosen direction out to a full site (blog index, post, page, search, 404) and packages it with DESIGN.md + decisions.md for html-to-block-theme; does not build the theme itself, but /iterate can apply feedback to a built theme after handoff.
